categories.main_business_segments: China Conch Venture Holdings Limited primarily operates in waste-to-energy projects, port logistics services, manufacturing and sales of new building materials, and new energy business including lithium battery recycling and new energy materials production. The company also invests in related environmental protection and energy-saving sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes grate furnace power generation technology for municipal waste treatment, waste treatment by cement kilns, and kitchen waste treatment. It employs integrated management and process optimization in lithium battery recycling and new energy materials production, including lithium iron phosphate cathode and anode materials. The company also focuses on energy-saving equipment design, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include local government authorities in China for waste incineration projects under BOT arrangements, industrial clients requiring energy-saving equipment, construction and building materials markets, and new energy sectors such as battery manufacturers. The company serves municipal waste management, environmental protection, and new energy industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, covering 23 provinces, cities, and autonomous regions with projects in Anhui, Guizhou, Chongqing, Yunnan, Hunan, Shaanxi, Hebei, Shandong, Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, and others. It also has operations in Asia-Pacific regions outside Mainland China, including Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Conch Venture Holdings operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection and new energy supply chain, focusing on waste treatment, energy generation from waste, manufacturing of energy-saving equipment and new materials, and logistics services. It also engages in upstream activities through investments and R&D in new energy materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-quality development, improving operational efficiency, and expanding green and sustainable industries. It focuses on R&D for advanced new energy materials, optimizing lithium battery recycling processes, and technological upgrades in waste-to-energy operations. Strategic priorities include expanding market share, enhancing product performance, and integrating industrial chains in green electricity and energy-saving manufacturing equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through construction and operation services of waste-to-energy projects, sales of energy-saving equipment, sales of new building materials, new energy business including cathode materials production and lithium battery recycling, and port logistics services. The company also receives finance income from service concession arrangements and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, China Conch Venture Holdings is positioned as a leading environmental protection and new energy company in China, with a strong presence in waste incineration and new energy materials. It maintains top ESG ratings in the construction and engineering sector in China, indicating a competitive advantage in sustainability and operational quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of RMB6.27 billion in 2024, a 21.76% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB2.02 billion, down 18.03%. Total assets reached RMB82.33 billion, with equity of RMB47.71 billion. Despite revenue decline due to fewer projects under construction, operational revenues in waste incineration increased, and new energy business revenue grew significantly by 176.68%. The company maintains a stable financial position with a gearing ratio of 40.27%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Conch Venture Holdings offers integrated environmental protection solutions focusing on waste-to-energy conversion, leveraging advanced grate furnace technology and comprehensive waste treatment services. Its value lies in high operational efficiency, strong government partnerships, extensive project portfolio across China, and innovation in new energy materials and lithium battery recycling. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon, and circular economy principles, supported by strong ESG performance and continuous technological upgrades.
